package rulefixtures

import gorm "gorm.io/gorm"

// scenario for association_find_inside_loop: GORM Association(...).Find(...) loaders observed inside loops.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
func getOrdersWithItems(db *gorm.DB, orderIDs []int) ([]Order, error) {
	var orders []Order

	if err := db.Where("id IN ?", orderIDs).Find(&orders).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	for i := range orders {
		var items []Item
		if err := db.Model(&orders[i]).Association("Items").Find(&items); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		orders[i].Items = items
	}

	return orders, nil
}

type Order struct {
	ID    int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Items []Item `gorm:"foreignKey:OrderID"`
}

type Item struct {
	ID      int `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	OrderID int
	Name    string
}
